requirement_text.REQ-043: Add the priv/repo/migrations and Ecto.Schema modules the instance engine needs but that S2 deliberately did not build, all schema-per-tenant via REQ-022's :prefix mechanism (Decision B's general rule for business tables -- none of these three is GLOBAL, and none needs REQ-041's GLOBAL-exception flagging, since R-Co's own 005_instances.sql tables are per-tenant like events/events_archive): (a) an ALTER TABLE migration on REQ-023's instance_projections adding exactly the columns REQ-023's own migration header (priv/repo/migrations/20260816120003_create_instance_projections.exs, "COLUMNS DELIBERATELY NOT CREATED HERE") names as S3/EE-01's job: definition_id (binary_id, not null), correlation_key (string, nullable), current_nodes (jsonb, default "[]" -- active token positions), variables (jsonb, default "{}" -- the merged variable map, seeded from EE-01's initial_variables per engine.md section EE-01 1a's "Note on initial_variables"), error_detail (jsonb, nullable -- set on ERROR status by EE-10), completed_at and cancelled_at (utc_datetime_usec, nullable), plus the two indexes REQ-023 names: uq_instance_correlation (UNIQUE on (definition_id, correlation_key) WHERE correlation_key IS NOT NULL -- the index that structurally enforces EE-01's correlation-key uniqueness acceptance criterion) and idx_proj_definition. The existing status Ecto.Enum already carries ERROR (REQ-023 included it deliberately, per that migration's header), so no enum migration is needed here -- confirm that rather than adding one. (b) a tasks table per engine.md section EE-03 1a (R-Co migrations/005_instances.sql): id (binary_id), instance_id (binary_id, not null, indexed), token_id (binary_id, not null), node_id (string, not null), node_name (string, not null), status (Ecto.Enum: PENDING/COMPLETED/CANCELLED, default PENDING), assignee_type (string, nullable -- USER|GROUP|ROLE), assignee_ref (string, nullable), form_schema (jsonb, nullable), output_variables (jsonb, nullable), completed_by (binary_id, nullable), completed_at/cancelled_at (utc_datetime_usec, nullable), timestamps(). R-Co's tasks logic lives in src/tasks/store.zig (1202 lines), a directory OUTSIDE this stage's src/engine/ scope -- this requirement builds only the table + schema module that src/engine/instance.zig writes into at EE-03 activation and EE-04 completion time; the standalone task query/list surface (src/tasks/store.zig's own list/filter operations) is NOT ported here and belongs with S4's tasks routes or its own later requirement. State that boundary in the moduledoc. (c) a tokens table: id (binary_id), instance_id (binary_id, not null), node_id (string), branch_id (string), plus whatever the EE-06/EE-07 parallel token model needs -- tasks.token_id references it. Because engine.md section EE-02 2 defines Token as an in-memory value (node_id/branch_id/token_id/waiting_child_instance_id) and instance_projections.current_nodes already persists active token positions as jsonb, flag explicitly in the moduledoc whether a separate tokens TABLE is genuinely required in Letflow or whether current_nodes subsumes it -- R-Co has both, but R-Co's tasks.token_id FK is the only thing that forces the separate table there. Do NOT silently drop the table or silently keep it; state which and why, since REQ-051's join counters and REQ-044's tasks FK both depend on the answer. tenant_id on every table above is NOT NULL with no DB default and is derived from the Ecto :prefix the write targets by reversing REQ-022's Letflow.TenantProvisioning.schema_name_for_tenant/1, exactly as REQ-025 and REQ-030 established for their own tables -- never a caller-supplied field.

task.description: Design the migrations and Ecto.Schema modules for REQ-043 (instance-engine schema: instance_projections ALTER + tasks table + tokens-table decision). Read the requirement text above in full, plus REQ-023's existing instance_projections migration (for the exact column list already deliberately NOT created there) and REQ-022's :prefix/tenant-scoping mechanism (for how tenant_id must be derived, not caller-supplied). Produce lib/letflow/design/req043-instance-engine-schema.md per WF-02 Step 1's standard shape: public function signatures with @spec-style types, Ecto schema field lists, DB migration specs (table/column/type/null/default/index), invariants, cross-module dependencies, and open questions. The tokens-table question (separate table vs. instance_projections.current_nodes subsuming it) must be resolved and justified in the design, not left open -- state the decision and why.
acceptance_criteria: Every REQ-043 acceptance criterion maps to a concrete design element

ALTER TABLE spec for instance_projections lists exactly the 7 named columns (definition_id, correlation_key, current_nodes, variables, error_detail, completed_at, cancelled_at) plus both named indexes (uq_instance_correlation partial unique, idx_proj_definition), and states explicitly that no enum migration is needed (ERROR already present)

tasks table spec is complete: all named columns with types/nullability/defaults, status Ecto.Enum restricted to exactly PENDING/COMPLETED/CANCELLED, and the schema module's moduledoc content is specified verbatim enough that ELIXIR-DEV cannot omit the src/tasks/store.zig-not-ported boundary statement
tokens table question resolved: design states whether a tokens table is built or current_nodes subsumes it, with reasoning tied to REQ-051's join counters and REQ-044's tasks FK
tenant_id derivation is specified as an internal function (signature + behavior), never a caller-supplied schema field, on every table
No implementation code (.ex/.exs bodies) -- signatures and type shapes only
